character_mapping_format.description: Same universal format as eye-library (see CUSTOMIZATION-LIBRARY-LAYOUT.md). To make every part work on a NEW character: add one entry here naming that character's eye/decal textures (texture_part) — mesh_parts attach at bone sockets and need no mapping, only optional per-character offsets.

texture_part_fields.rect: pixel rect to composite into (full replace if omitted)
texture_part_fields.replaces_texture: texture name in that character's GLB

baek.character: Baek / Kevin — Master White (Tekken 7 rip, pek1u texture set). Mapped 2026-10-21 (round 2) from texture evidence: per-material mean colors of baek-master-white-rigged.glb — skin mats are the warm-tan set, hair mats the dark-brown set. Round 1 loud-failed here (mapping was null, so colors.skin/colors.hair never applied).

how_to_use: 2. Texture parts: resolveEntry(entry, charId) merges the character's mapping; swapTexture() replaces the texture live — swap back restores the original (nothing overwritten).
3. Mesh parts: attachPart() routes to attach() at the registry socket (bone aliases shared across rigs) with optional fit=headHeight auto-scale.
4. Web UI (customization/create-fighter/): Catalog gains the eyes / decals / masks categories sourced from the same entries.
